name: Ramandolo

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata e Garantita, Italy's top tier. Stricter than DOC, and given only to wines that have been DOC for at least seven years.

blurb.text: A sweet white DOCG from the hills near Nimis in Friuli-Venezia Giulia, made from a local Verduzzo variety, Verduzzo Friulano.
